newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Australia firm in Malaysia airport contract - paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia firm in Malaysia airport contract - paper.

text.p: Australian-based Transfield Holdings Sdn Bhd has won a 250 million ringgit ($100.2 million) contract to build catering facilities at the new Kuala Lumpur international airport, The Star newspaper said on Saturday.
The project, awarded by Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) subsidiary MAS Catering Sdn Bhd, will be ready when the airport located in Sepang opens by January 1998.
"The MAS Catering kitchen at Sepang will be the largest kitchen in Southeast Asia," Transfield regional director Luca Belgiorno-Nettis told the daily.
The catering facilities would cover the size of two football fields and produce 30,000 meals a day, he said.
Transfield is a sub-contractor in a highway construction in Malaysia led by MTD Capital Bhd.
